provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.ar: نظام أرقام واحد في العدد الواحد وفي الشاشة الواحدة
title.en: One numeral system per number and per screen

statement.ar: لا تعرض عددًا تختلط فيه أرقام نظامين، ولا شاشة بعض كمياتها بالأرقام اللاتينية وبعضها بالعربية المشرقية. التحويل يتم على المحارف نفسها لا بخاصية خط.
statement.en: Never display a number that mixes digits of two systems, nor a screen where some quantities use Latin digits and others Arabic-Indic. Conversion is done on the characters themselves, not by a font feature.

rationale.ar: الاختلاط يوحي بأن القيمتين من مصدرين مختلفين ويربك المقارنة. والاعتماد على الخط لتبديل الأشكال يجعل ما يُنسخ مختلفًا عما يُرى.
rationale.en: Mixing suggests the two values come from different sources and hinders comparison. Relying on a font to swap shapes makes what is copied differ from what is seen.

checks: Within one locale scope, every digit in rendered text outside identifiers belongs to the scope's numeral system.
No formatted number contains code points from more than one of U+0030–0039, U+0660–0669, U+06F0–06F9.
The text copied from a number equals its rendered code points.
